conclusion: Added frozen-parent F3 often makes a small metric-depth correction. Its boundary-band error benefit does not imply more complete or sharper depth discontinuities; direct parent panels confirm specific lost edge matches. Retain negative and inconclusive results; do not describe all images or all metrics as improved.
